summary: Frontend testing of new EWMA-based cycle tracking and extension flow logic complete. All 6 critical scenarios PASS: normal cycle day calc, extended cycle banner at avg+2, capped UI 'Day X+' at avg+7, confirm-extension flow, deny-extension flow with date reset, and EWMA average shown in Cycle History dialog (29 days EWMA vs 30 days simple avg for lengths [25,35,25,35]).

issues: Radix Dialog warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking but a11y improvement recommended

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Cycle History dialog to silence Radix warning
critical_code_review_comments: EWMA formula in cycleCalculations.js works correctly: new_avg = 0.3*latest + 0.7*previous_avg, seeded with first cycle length. Verified [25,35,25,35] -> 29 (vs simple 30).
getDisplayCycleDay caps at average+7 and is_capped flag drives 'Day X+' UI display correctly (cycleInfo.cycle_day=35, is_capped=true renders 'Day 35+').
getCycleExtensionStatus boundaries: normal (<=avg+2), extended (avg+2 < d <= avg+7), capped (d > avg+7) — Day 31 with avg 28 correctly maps to 'extended' (banner shows); Day 36 maps to 'capped'.
Extension state persistence via LocalStorage.saveExtensionState() correctly stores {confirmed, alertShownForCycleStart, cappedMessageShown, updatedAt} base64-encoded.
handleDenyExtension flow correctly: adds new cycle entry with denyDate, updates partner.cycleStartDate, clears extension state, resets to Day 1 (Day 2 when denyDate is yesterday).
Phase override in getPhaseInfo: when cycleDay > averageLength, phase forced to 'Late Luteal/PMS' with playful 'cycle extended' messaging — works as expected.
Dashboard.jsx is 1674 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting cycle-info/history/extension-banner into separate components.
Minor: Dialog cycle history dialog missing DialogDescription causing console a11y warning.

seed_data_creation: All scenarios use in-browser localStorage seeding via page.evaluate (base64-encoded JSON for cyclecoach_partner_profile, cyclecoach_cycle_history, cyclecoach_extension_state). Plain-string 'true' for cyclecoach_state_waiver_complete and cyclecoach_consent_granted.

'cyclecoach_partner_profile', 'cyclecoach_cycle_history', 'cyclecoach_extension_state' are base64(JSON.stringify(data)). Login required first (testuser@test.com / Test1234). After setting localStorage, page.reload() to trigger Dashboard load. Cycle-day text uses data-testid='cycle-day' (e.g., 'Day 31', 'Day 35+'). Banner: data-testid='extension-banner' with 'confirm-extension-btn' and 'deny-extension-btn'. Capped message: data-testid='capped-cycle-message' with 'Internal count: Day N'. Cycle history toggle: 'toggle-cycle-history-button'.
